messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Hey @Priyanka — putting together a focused manager/HR onboarding checklist for Tara (starts Mon). Kept it manager-friendly + measurable. Please flag owners and any role-specific tweaks. :sparkles:

Priyanka (Hiring Manager): Thanks! Posting edits inline. Love the measurable goals. I'll own codebase walkthrough and first-week pairing.

Aisha (People Ops): Compact first-week agenda (copy/paste):
```
Pre-start (Fri): badge request submitted, laptop shipped, SSO invite + calendar share
Day 1 AM: HR intro + paperwork (payroll, benefits), manager 1:1 for expectations
Day 1 PM: Team standup, team intros, badge/VPN verification, lunch w/ mentor
Day 2: Product & roadmap overview, architecture tour, read-only repo access
Day 3: Dev workflow, CI/CD demo, first small scoped ticket assigned (pairing)
Day 4: Security & compliance briefing, infra access review, prod runbook walkthrough
Day 5: 1-week sync (manager + people ops), set 30-day priorities, schedule 30/60/90 review cadence
```

Aisha (People Ops): 30/60/90 starter (manager-focused, measurable):
- 30d: onboard to core repo, merge 1 small change, complete security checklist, meet key stakeholders (prod, infra, support). Owner: Priyanka
- 60d: own a customer-facing bugfix or small feature end-to-end, present learnings to the team, mentor shadow. Owner: Priyanka + Mentor
- 90d: deliver a medium scope change with follow-up metrics (latency/regression/err rate), propose 1 process improvement. Owner: Manager + Eng Ops

Priyanka (Hiring Manager): Additions: schedule skip-level w/ VP in week 2 (30m). Assign Sasha as mentor for pairing week 1. Also want Tara in customer-support sync on Thurs.

Onboarding Bot: Calendar events queued: "Tara Week1: HR + Tech Kickoff" Mon 09:30, "Repo walkthrough" Tue 10:00, "Security Brief" Wed 15:00, "1-week sync" Fri 16:00. Invites sent to Tara, Priyanka, Sasha, Aisha, Ben.

Tara (New Hire): Thanks all! Tiny question: will badge/office access be active day 1? Also, who do I ping if VPN doesn't authenticate?

Ben (Security): Badge request done by Facilities. If badge delayed, let me know and I'll create a temporary guest pass. VPN auth: ping infra-auth channel and cc me if you need expedited MFA reset.

Aisha (People Ops): Who-to-ask quick list:
- Laptop / badge / SSO: Aisha (People Ops) -> Facilities (cc Ben if security concern)
- Repo / CI perms: Priyanka (Manager) -> eng-infra
- Payroll / benefits: Aisha (People Ops)
- Security access / prod keys: Ben (Security)
- Calendar / invites: Onboarding Bot / People Ops

Priyanka (Hiring Manager): For metrics, let's make the 30d merge be reviewed within 3 days and deployed to staging within 1 week. I'll add those to the hiring tracker.

Aisha (People Ops): Great. I'll post a short Slack intro Friday with a one-liner bio and the first-week calendar. Anything else before Monday? :point_down:

Tara (New Hire): All set from my side. Appreciate the clarity and the measurable goals — helps a lot. See you Monday! :wave:
